title: Fix Rich Text Content Rendering on Public Blog Pages
description: Fix broken HTML rendering on public blog pages. TipTap saves content as HTML strings but the public site renders them as plain text with visible tags.

stories.title: Install and configure dependencies
stories.description: Install isomorphic-dompurify and @tailwindcss/typography, then register the typography plugin in globals.css.
acceptanceCriteria: isomorphic-dompurify is added to frontend/package.json dependencies
@tailwindcss/typography is registered as a Tailwind CSS v4 plugin in frontend/app/globals.css (via @plugin "@tailwindcss/typography")

stories.title: Sanitize and render post content on the single post page
stories.description: Sanitize post.content with isomorphic-dompurify and render via dangerouslySetInnerHTML with prose Tailwind classes.
acceptanceCriteria: post.content is sanitized using isomorphic-dompurify's sanitize() before being passed to the DOM
The content container uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: sanitizedHtml }} to render the HTML
The content container has Tailwind's prose class (and prose-lg dark:prose-invert for sizing and dark mode)
The existing whitespace-pre-wrap class is removed from the content container

stories.title: Fix plain-text excerpt in PostCard
stories.description: Strip HTML tags from post.content before generating the excerpt so PostCard shows readable text.
acceptanceCriteria: Before calling generateExcerpt(), all HTML tags are stripped from post.content
The excerpt shows actual post text with no HTML tags visible
Stripping done with regex directly in PostCard.tsx
Existing line-clamp-3 and word-count truncation behavior is preserved
